description: Phase 407/411 + chainVersion cross-host op-stream chain corpus. Each record: decode opFixture, computeHash(prev, op, sequence, ts, actor, promptId, result); assert hash + previousHash. The pre-image envelope is `{"v":2,"op":...,"ts":...,"promptId":...,"result":...}` — `v` (the chain FORMAT version) is folded FIRST into the hash, so the format is self-describing and tamper-evident; bump it in lock-step across F#/TS/Python and this golden whenever the pre-image formula / envelope shape / HashFn changes. `sequence` is the domain's 1-based value; the pre-image folds Core's 0-based record index (sequence - 1, Phase 411). Both the F# and TS hosts assert their chain reproduces these bytes. Generated by the canonical F# HashChain.computeHash (envelope + Core-canonical payload + SHA-256).
